cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Helpful Culprit
cards.instruction: Hide that the problem is your fault while enthusiastically helping investigate it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I've started investigating the broken vase. First, we check the window.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why have you got glue on your fingers?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Excellent clue. I'll inspect the glue cupboard personally.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A piece of vase is stuck to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put me in charge of preserving it.

mechanism: A imitates investigative gestures badly while volunteering to handle evidence that implicates A.
confusable: S04 confusion concerns investigation method; D13 concealment concerns actual responsibility, which dialogue must make legible.
comparison: Broken object evidence versus document mishap.
seedUse: D13-a physical clue follows A into investigation; do not reuse protected hamster pair dialogue.
